items.name: Book of Fighting
items.info: Instantly finish any troop upgrade. Works in both villages!

items.name: Book of Building
items.info: Instantly finish any building upgrade. Works in both villages!

items.name: Book of Spells
items.info: Instantly finish any spell upgrade in Home Village.

items.name: Book of Heroes
items.info: Instantly finish a Hero or Pet upgrade. Works in both villages!

items.name: Book of Everything
items.info: Instantly finish any upgrade. Works in both villages!

items.name: Power Potion
items.info: Boost Troops, Spells, and Siege Machines to their maximum level allowed by your Town Hall for 1h. Works in both Villages!

items.name: Resource Potion
items.info: Boost resource collector efficiency for <time> in Home Village.

items.name: Training Potion
items.info: This energetic Elixir boosts your Army production, increasing efficiency of Barracks, Spell Factories, Workshop and Hero regeneration for <time>. Works in Home Village.

items.name: Rune of Gold
items.info: Completely fill your Gold Storages in Home Village.

items.name: Rune of Elixir
items.info: Completely fill your Elixir Storages in Home Village.

items.name: Rune of Dark Elixir
items.info: Completely fill your Dark Elixir storages in Home Village.

items.name: Rune of Builder Gold
items.info: Completely fill your Builder Gold Storages in Builder Base.

items.name: Rune of Builder Elixir
items.info: Completely fill your Builder Elixir Storages in Builder Base.

items.name: Wall Ring
items.info: Instantly upgrade a wall piece. Some higher level walls may require multiple rings to upgrade. Requires a free Builder. Works in both villages!

items.name: Builder Potion
items.info: Boost Builder work to 10x its regular speed for <time> in Home Village. The Builder's Apprentice will not be affected.

items.name: Hammer of Fighting
items.info: Instantly upgrade any Troop to the next level. Works in both Villages!

items.name: Hammer of Building
items.info: Instantly upgrade any Building to the next level. Requires a free Builder. Works in both Villages!

items.name: Hammer of Spells
items.info: Instantly upgrade any Spell to the next level in Home Village.

items.name: Hammer of Heroes
items.info: Instantly upgrade any Hero or Pet to the next level. Works in both Villages!

items.name: Clock Tower Potion
items.info: Activate Clock Tower boost for <time>. Works in Builder Base!

items.name: Shovel of Obstacles
items.info: Strong but fragile, this magical shovel can be used to make a single obstacle permanently movable. Works in both villages!

items.name: Hero Potion
items.info: Boost all Heroes and Pets to their maximum level allowed by your Town Hall for <time>. Works in both Villages!

items.name: Research Potion
items.info: Boost Laboratory research to <multiplier>x its regular speed in Home Village for <time>. The Lab Assistant will not be affected.

items.name: Super Potion
items.info: Can Boost a Troop into its Super Troop form for 3 days!

items.name: Pet Potion
items.info: Boost Pet upgrades to <multiplier>x their regular speed for <time>.

items.name: Builder Star Jar
items.info: Instantly make your Star Bonus available in Builder Base.
